runtime.rendering: immediate-mode HTML5 Canvas 2D, logical ~400x720, DPR-aware scaling
runtime.persistence: localStorage first; Firebase auth/cloud-save optional, must not block offline
runtime.pwa: manifest.json + sw.js installable offline fallback; firebase-config.js git-ignored
